text.arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name as definite subject, carrying uniqueness and refuge while heading the proof that follows
words.root_gloss_range: root range associated with deity, worship, refuge, and disputed bewildered turning; locally anchored as the fixed proper divine name
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) opens as the known, definite subject. The predicate is delayed while the relative proof unfolds through creation and throne-governance, so the later denial of any protector or intercessor returns to this one named referent, and the closing remembrance question asks the audience to retrieve the recognition first named here. The worship-and-refuge pressure in the name makes the no-intermediary clause feel like the consequence of the opening identity, and the creation formula register (7:54; 10:3; 25:59; 57:4) places the ayah inside a known proof pattern.

topics.headline: definite subject delays the payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader starts from a maximally definite divine subject whose practical implication is delayed until the proof is complete.
topics.reason: The reader starts from a maximally definite divine subject whose practical implication is delayed until the proof is complete.

topics.headline: worship and refuge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the name as the unique refuge and worship focus, while local grammar keeps it as the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The reader hears the name as the unique refuge and worship focus, while local grammar keeps it as the proper divine name.

topics.headline: creation formula register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a creation-governance register before the ayah applies it to the audience.
topics.reason: The reader recognizes a creation-governance register before the ayah applies it to the audience.

topics.headline: single head of the argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the no-helper denial and remembrance question unfolding from the opening subject rather than as separate claims.
topics.reason: The reader sees the no-helper denial and remembrance question unfolding from the opening subject rather than as separate claims.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun binding creation and governance as the predicate-proof for the divine name
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) turns the opening name into a proof-bearing description. It locks the following acts to the same divine subject and keeps creation plus throne-governance inside one relative-clause span before the address turns toward the audience.

topics.headline: relative clause makes identity proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divine subject identified by performed acts across one proof unit, not by a detached title.
topics.reason: The reader sees the divine subject identified by performed acts across one proof unit, not by a detached title.

words.gloss_range: completed Form I creation: direct, transitive, measured origination of the cosmic domains rather than fabrication or iterative self-fashioning
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans creating, forming, measuring, and fabricating; local objects select true cosmic origination while allowing measured-formation pressure
words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقَ}} ({{tr:khalaqa}}) begins the finite action proof as a completed direct act. Its object field expands through the heavens, earth, and the between-space, so creation is the ordered origin of the whole domain. The broader fabricate branch is narrowed here by the cosmic objects: the local sense is true measured origination, with formed-nature pressure rather than bare making. The Form I shape keeps the act direct, and the formula carries the surah from mission context into cosmic proof and then into human formation and resurrection dispute (32:7; 32:10).

topics.headline: completed act gathers three domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees creation as an accomplished act gathering all three spatial domains under one verb.
topics.reason: The reader sees creation as an accomplished act gathering all three spatial domains under one verb.

topics.headline: true measured origination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the fabricate branch only as a contrast; the local cosmic frame selects true, measured creation.
topics.reason: The reader notices the fabricate branch only as a contrast; the local cosmic frame selects true, measured creation.

topics.headline: Form I direct act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices direct origination rather than intensive reshaping or self-fashioning.
topics.reason: The reader notices direct origination rather than intensive reshaping or self-fashioning.

topics.headline: formula opens the wider arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the creation formula as the first stage of an argument that later reaches human formation and resurrection dispute.
topics.reason: The reader recognizes the creation formula as the first stage of an argument that later reaches human formation and resurrection dispute.

words.gloss_range: definite plural heavens as a known, elevated, layered upper realm and first pole of the created totality
words.root_gloss_range: root range centers on height, elevation, and sky or canopy; local plural noun selects the elevated-heavens domain while contested marking pressure is secondary
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) names a known upper realm, not an unnamed sky. Its plural form makes elevation layered, and its position as the first object starts the spatial architecture that will add earth and the between-space. The elevation derivation is selected locally, while marking pressure remains narrowed background. In 32:5 the created upper realm becomes the route of command, so created space immediately prepares governance flow.

topics.headline: known layered upper realm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heavens as a definite, plural, elevated domain and first pole of created totality.
topics.reason: The reader sees the heavens as a definite, plural, elevated domain and first pole of created totality.

topics.headline: elevation selected over marking dispute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retains the derivational dispute only as pressure while the local noun selects elevated heavens.
topics.reason: The reader retains the derivational dispute only as pressure while the local noun selects elevated heavens.

topics.headline: first pole in three-zone cosmos
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the upper realm as the first pole in an exhaustive above-below-between structure.
topics.reason: The reader sees the upper realm as the first pole in an exhaustive above-below-between structure.

topics.headline: created heavens become command route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the created heavens in 32:4 becoming the vertical route of command in 32:5.
topics.reason: The reader notices the created heavens in 32:4 becoming the vertical route of command in 32:5.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining earth to the heavens under the same completed creation verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the lower realm inside the same creative predicate as the upper realm. The connector builds the two-pole cosmos that the later dual suffix will treat as a pair.

topics.headline: earth joined under same act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees earth placed on equal grammatical footing with the heavens under the same act of creation.
topics.reason: The reader sees earth placed on equal grammatical footing with the heavens under the same act of creation.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth as lower created domain, grounded substrate, and co-object with the heavens
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers earth, land, ground, soil, and lower substrate; local use selects the created lower realm in the cosmic pair
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضَ}} ({{tr:al-arḍa}}) is not merely a setting beneath the heavens; it is a conjoined object of the same completed creation act. Its singular form gives the lower realm one grounded substrate facing the plural upper realm, and the fixed heavens-earth pairing makes the phrase a totality marker. Later in the surah, earth becomes command destination, disputed return, and revivified field (32:5; 32:10; 32:27).

topics.headline: earth as co-object and ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees earth as a directly created object and grounded lower substrate.
topics.reason: The reader sees earth as a directly created object and grounded lower substrate.

topics.headline: singular ground against plural heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one earth facing multiple heavens before the interval is named.
topics.reason: The reader notices one earth facing multiple heavens before the interval is named.

topics.headline: fixed pair continues through surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the heavens-earth pair as a fixed totality marker that continues through the surah.
topics.reason: The reader recognizes the heavens-earth pair as a fixed totality marker that continues through the surah.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding the between-space as a third created domain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) extends the heavens-earth pair into a three-part created field. By coordinating the interval phrase, it makes the middle realm explicit rather than leaving it as an assumed gap.

topics.headline: connector promotes the middle realm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the middle space is explicitly added to creation rather than left implied.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the middle space is explicitly added to creation rather than left implied.

words.gloss_range: open-ended relative pronoun covering whatever occupies the interval between heavens and earth
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) refuses to list the contents of the middle realm. As an open relative object, it brings whatever lies between the two poles under the same act of creation, preventing the heavens-earth pair from leaving an unclaimed gap.

topics.headline: open relative covers the interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the interval filled by an unrestricted relative pronoun, so no class of intermediate created things is left outside the claim.
topics.reason: The reader sees the interval filled by an unrestricted relative pronoun, so no class of intermediate created things is left outside the claim.

words.gloss_range: the between-space of the two cosmic poles, with dual suffix compressing heavens and earth into one interval relation
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers being between, separation, distinction, and clarity; local adverbial use selects spatial interval with clarity pressure
words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَهُمَا}} ({{tr:baynahumā}}) packages the plural heavens and singular earth as two poles with a middle between them. Grammatically it locates the open relative phrase rather than adding a fourth object. The root distinction-and-clarity pressure survives in narrowed form: the interval is spatial, but it also makes the two created poles legible as a relation. This total created space frames the practical denial that follows.

topics.headline: dual suffix makes two poles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees plural heavens and singular earth compressed into two poles around one interval.
topics.reason: The reader sees plural heavens and singular earth compressed into two poles around one interval.

topics.headline: between-space marks distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the interval both separates the poles and makes their relation legible, while the local sense remains spatial.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the interval both separates the poles and makes their relation legible, while the local sense remains spatial.

topics.headline: total space frames no-proxy claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees cosmic totality framing the later denial of intermediaries and the closing demand.
topics.reason: The reader sees cosmic totality framing the later denial of intermediaries and the closing demand.

words.gloss_range: preposition of containment applied to the six-period temporal frame
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns the following number phrase into a time-container for creation. Its ordinary containment force is carried into temporal language, so the ayah presents creation as occurring within six periods.

topics.headline: creation placed within time-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the six periods as the enclosing temporal frame of creation, not as a loose afterthought.
topics.reason: The reader sees the six periods as the enclosing temporal frame of creation, not as a loose afterthought.

words.gloss_range: the counted number six in the creation-period formula, grammatically bound to the following periods
words.root_gloss_range: limited root payoff here; local force is numerical and formulaic rather than a rich independent root field
words.prose: {{ar:سِتَّةِ}} ({{tr:sittati}}) is grammatically bound to the following periods through the number pattern, and its main weight is formulaic rather than symbolic. It helps close the creation unit as measured, staged time before the ayah moves through the next connector into throne-governance.

topics.headline: gender-polarity binds the count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the number grammatically locked to the following counted periods.
topics.reason: The reader sees the number grammatically locked to the following counted periods.

topics.headline: six as creation marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats six as a creation-period formula marker rather than a symbolically overloaded standalone number.
topics.reason: The reader treats six as a creation-period formula marker rather than a symbolically overloaded standalone number.

topics.headline: number phrase closes creation unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices measured time closing the creation segment just before throne-governance.
topics.reason: The reader notices measured time closing the creation segment just before throne-governance.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural periods in the creation formula: counted but unnamed, temporally elastic, and not forced into one narrow scale
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers day, time, period, and decisive time; local plural supports creation periods without specifying their scale
words.prose: {{ar:أَيَّامٍ}} ({{tr:ayyāmin}}) keeps the six periods countable but unnamed. The tanwīn and plural form do not force a narrow twenty-four-hour reading; they leave the creation stages unspecified while preserving the count. The phrase belongs to the repeated six-period creation formula (7:54; 10:3; 11:7; 25:59; 41:9-12; 50:38; 57:4), and 32:5 immediately shows the same time-root working at a very different scale.

topics.headline: indefinite plural periods remain unspecified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices real counted periods whose scale is not narrowed to named or uniform ordinary days.
topics.reason: The reader notices real counted periods whose scale is not narrowed to named or uniform ordinary days.

topics.headline: recognized six-period formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as a repeated creation-period formula, with 32:4 leaving the stages undivided.
topics.reason: The reader recognizes the phrase as a repeated creation-period formula, with 32:4 leaving the stages undivided.

topics.headline: time shifts into command scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees time move from creation duration in 32:4 to command-scale time in 32:5 and later accountability.
topics.reason: The reader sees time move from creation duration in 32:4 to command-scale time in 32:5 and later accountability.

words.gloss_range: delayed sequential connector moving from completed creation to throne-governance within one proof clause
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) stages the proof. Creation is complete, and then the ayah moves to establishment over the throne; the delay matters, but both acts remain inside the same relative-clause argument before the audience is confronted.

topics.headline: delayed sequence to governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels creation and throne-governance as staged acts rather than simultaneous clauses.
topics.reason: The reader feels creation and throne-governance as staged acts rather than simultaneous clauses.

topics.headline: two predicates remain one proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the staged acts still contained inside one relative-clause proof.
topics.reason: The reader sees the staged acts still contained inside one relative-clause proof.

words.gloss_range: completed Form VIII establishment in the throne-governance construction, selecting mastery upon while retaining balance and order pressure
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers being level, equal, balanced, formed, and established; local construction with the following preposition selects elevated establishment and governance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَوَىٰ}} ({{tr:istawā}}) carries the same divine subject into the second completed act. The root can press toward leveling and balance, but the local construction selects establishment upon the throne, so equilibrium is felt as ordered sovereignty rather than mere flatness. Its Form VIII shape adds self-establishment. The repeated creation-then-throne formula (7:54; 10:3; 13:2; 20:5; 25:59; 57:4) makes governance the sequel to creating the cosmos, and the same root later moves into human shaping and moral non-equivalence (32:9; 32:18).

topics.headline: same subject completes second act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees throne-establishment as a completed second act by the same divine subject.
topics.reason: The reader sees throne-establishment as a completed second act by the same divine subject.

topics.headline: leveling pressure selected as mastery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels equilibrium and sovereignty together, while the local construction selects establishment upon rather than mere leveling.
topics.reason: The reader feels equilibrium and sovereignty together, while the local construction selects establishment upon rather than mere leveling.

topics.headline: self-establishment without external agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices self-establishment rather than being made level by another.
topics.reason: The reader notices self-establishment rather than being made level by another.

topics.headline: repeated throne-governance formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as a creation-then-governance set piece that later echoes through human shaping and moral contrast.
topics.reason: The reader recognizes the phrase as a creation-then-governance set piece that later echoes through human shaping and moral contrast.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the throne complement and selecting overness, establishment, and authority in the local construction
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) is the constructional hinge that steers the verb toward establishment over the throne. It governs the following object and turns spatial overness into a sovereignty relation, so the phrase is not a loose image of leveling.

topics.headline: overness selects governance complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the preposition disambiguating the verb toward establishment over an elevated object and sovereign relation.
topics.reason: The reader sees the preposition disambiguating the verb toward establishment over an elevated object and sovereign relation.

words.gloss_range: definite singular throne as known elevated authority-symbol, with raised-framework pressure in the governance formula
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers throne, raised structure, roof, canopy, and trellis or framework; local use selects the throne while preserving architectural support imagery
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَرْشِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿarshi}}) is definite and singular, so the ayah treats the throne as a known authority-symbol. The root raised-framework field remains useful: rule is pictured not only as royal seat but as elevated ordering structure. Positioned after creation and measured time, the throne clause becomes the pivot from cosmology to accountability.

topics.headline: known singular authority symbol
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the throne as a known, singular authority symbol, not as one item among many seats.
topics.reason: The reader sees the throne as a known, singular authority symbol, not as one item among many seats.

topics.headline: throne with framework pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the throne as sovereignty with raised-framework support, while the local phrase still selects the throne-governance sense.
topics.reason: The reader feels the throne as sovereignty with raised-framework support, while the local phrase still selects the throne-governance sense.

topics.headline: throne clause pivots to accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees throne-governance as the hinge from cosmic creation to the denial of intermediaries and the demand to remember.
topics.reason: The reader sees throne-governance as the hinge from cosmic creation to the denial of intermediaries and the demand to remember.

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening the categorical denial of audience possession of any protector or intercessor
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) pivots the ayah from proof to confrontation. It negates the whole possession clause, so the audience is not merely told they lack a preferred helper; the existence of any available protector or intercessor outside Him is denied before the closing question presses them to remember.

topics.headline: whole possession clause negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the existence of available intermediaries denied for the audience.
topics.reason: The reader sees the existence of available intermediaries denied for the audience.

topics.headline: cosmic proof becomes confrontation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the turn from third-person cosmic report into second-person accountability.
topics.reason: The reader feels the turn from third-person cosmic report into second-person accountability.

words.gloss_range: prepositional possession or benefit phrase with second-person plural suffix under negation
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) makes the denial land on the audience. The grammar asks what is available for them or to their benefit, and the answer is none. The plural address also shifts the discourse from the mission frame in 32:3 into public accountability, matching the final plural demand to remember.

topics.headline: audience denied possession and benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial aimed at what is available for the audience, not at an abstract doctrine alone.
topics.reason: The reader sees the denial aimed at what is available for the audience, not at an abstract doctrine alone.

topics.headline: plural audience takes proof personally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from prior mission framing into collective second-person accountability.
topics.reason: The reader notices the shift from prior mission framing into collective second-person accountability.

words.gloss_range: first preposition of exclusion or source in the outside-Him phrase, distinct from the later emphatic particle
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) opens the exclusion field: anything imagined outside Him is the domain being denied. It also differs from the later emphatic particle, so the repeated form is layered rather than redundant. Across the boundary from 32:3, source language turns into exclusion language: truth comes from God, and no rival authority can be sourced apart from Him.

topics.headline: first source particle marks exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees an outside-Him domain opened only to be emptied of helpers.
topics.reason: The reader sees an outside-Him domain opened only to be emptied of helpers.

topics.headline: source language answers prior truth source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that truth comes from God and the outside-Him domain cannot validate a rival authority.
topics.reason: The reader notices that truth comes from God and the outside-Him domain cannot validate a rival authority.

words.gloss_range: below or besides-Him exclusion phrase, pronominally tied to God and scoping over the denied intermediary roles
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers below, lesser than, besides, and record or register derivatives; local use selects relational exclusion with lower-rank pressure
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِهِ}} ({{tr:dūnihī}}) measures every possible outside claim against Him specifically. The phrase carries both besides and lower-rank pressure: whatever is imagined apart from Him is already beneath the creator-governor just named. The record or court branch is only a narrowed color near the intercession field; the local sense remains exclusion. Structurally, the phrase scopes over both denied agents and turns cosmic sovereignty into a practical no-proxy claim, while the below/besides scale returns later with lesser punishment before greater accountability (32:21).

topics.headline: below or besides measured by pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exclusion measured directly against the divine referent, with both besides and lower-rank pressure.
topics.reason: The reader sees exclusion measured directly against the divine referent, with both besides and lower-rank pressure.

topics.headline: register-court pressure remains secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may feel a light administrative or courtly color near intercession, while the local sense remains below or besides Him.
topics.reason: The reader may feel a light administrative or courtly color near intercession, while the local sense remains below or besides Him.

topics.headline: outside-Him phrase scopes over agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one outside-Him field covering both protector and intercessor, tightened by the two-particle construction.
topics.reason: The reader sees one outside-Him field covering both protector and intercessor, tightened by the two-particle construction.

topics.headline: below sense recurs in punishment scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the below/besides root returning in 32:21 as a lesser-before-greater scale marker.
topics.reason: The reader notices the below/besides root returning in 32:21 as a lesser-before-greater scale marker.

words.gloss_range: emphatic second preposition after negation, converting the protector denial into zero-instance force
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is the tightening particle before the indefinite protector noun. After the outside-Him phrase has set the excluded domain, this second particle intensifies the negation: not even a single protector remains available.

topics.headline: second particle intensifies class denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears not merely no protector in general, but not even one instance from the class.
topics.reason: The reader hears not merely no protector in general, but not even one instance from the class.

words.gloss_range: indefinite protector or patron under exhaustive negation, with nearness-authority pressure and no-proxy force
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers nearness, adjacency, authority, guardianship, patronage, and taking charge; local use selects a standing protector or patron role
words.prose: {{ar:وَلِىٍّ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}) is indefinite under intensified negation, so the whole protector class is denied. Its root makes protection concrete: authority comes through nearness and taking charge, so the ayah removes any close authorized patron apart from God. The broader patron/client family widens the denied intermediary field, but the local role remains protector. Paired with the intercessor noun in a recurring no-intermediary formula (6:51; 6:70; 39:3), it makes the closing remembrance demand impossible to delegate.

topics.headline: indefinite protector class denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a standing protector role removed as a class, not only one named patron.
topics.reason: The reader sees a standing protector role removed as a class, not only one named patron.

topics.headline: protection rooted in nearness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied protector is a close authorized patron, not a vague helper.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the denied protector is a close authorized patron, not a vague helper.

topics.headline: master-client range widens field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wider patron/client range broadening the denied intermediary field, while local grammar selects protector.
topics.reason: The reader sees the wider patron/client range broadening the denied intermediary field, while local grammar selects protector.

topics.headline: protector pairs with intercessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the protector denial as one half of a recurrent no-intermediary pair that makes remembrance non-delegable.
topics.reason: The reader sees the protector denial as one half of a recurrent no-intermediary pair that makes remembrance non-delegable.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding the second denied intermediary class under the same negation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the denial forward to a second class. It keeps intercession inside the same negative field while allowing the second role to remain semantically distinct from protection.

topics.headline: connector extends same negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the intercessor added under the same negated field without collapsing it into the protector role.
topics.reason: The reader sees the intercessor added under the same negated field without collapsing it into the protector role.

words.gloss_range: renewed negative particle before the intercessor noun, making the second denial explicit
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews the negation before the intercessor noun. The result is a neither-nor structure: the second category is grammatically parallel to the first, yet explicitly denied in its own right.

topics.headline: second denial made explicit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears intercession denied independently, not only inferred from coordination.
topics.reason: The reader hears intercession denied independently, not only inferred from coordination.

words.gloss_range: indefinite intercessor or advocate under renewed negation, with pairing imagery and class-wide denial
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers pairing, making even, joining, and intercession; local use selects the advocate who would add a second voice to a plea
words.prose: {{ar:شَفِيعٍ}} ({{tr:shafīʿin}}) is the second denied intermediary role. Its indefinite form under renewed negation removes the class, while its root makes intercession concrete: the intercessor is the one who would pair a lone plea with another voice. The intercession denial belongs to a wider denial constellation (2:48; 2:254; 6:51; 6:70; 74:48), and together with the protector noun it blocks both imagined routes of mediation, authority through nearness and advocacy through added support.

topics.headline: indefinite intercessor class denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a stable intercessor role removed as a class and made parallel to the protector denial.
topics.reason: The reader sees a stable intercessor role removed as a class and made parallel to the protector denial.

topics.headline: intercession as added voice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures intercession as pairing or doubling a lone plea, and the ayah denies that added voice apart from God.
topics.reason: The reader pictures intercession as pairing or doubling a lone plea, and the ayah denies that added voice apart from God.

topics.headline: protector and intercessor exhaust routes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the two denied nouns covering authority/proximity and advocacy/pairing routes for imagined intermediaries.
topics.reason: The reader sees the two denied nouns covering authority/proximity and advocacy/pairing routes for imagined intermediaries.

words.gloss_range: consequential connector inside the closing rhetorical question, linking the preceding denial to demanded reflection
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the closing question follow from what has just been proven and denied. The ayah does not simply change topics; it converts creation, governance, and no-intermediary negation into an accountability question. In the compact closing formula, the particle helps turn evidence into a demand for remembrance.

topics.headline: consequence particle turns proof into question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing question as the consequence of the proof and no-intermediary denial, not a new topic.
topics.reason: The reader hears the closing question as the consequence of the proof and no-intermediary denial, not a new topic.

topics.headline: triple-particle accountability formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closing form as a rebuking accountability question that turns evidence into demanded remembrance.
topics.reason: The reader recognizes the closing form as a rebuking accountability question that turns evidence into demanded remembrance.

words.gloss_range: negative particle inside the rhetorical question, expecting reversal into remembrance
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is not a calm denial here. Inside the rhetorical question, it creates the expected reversal: will you not remember means that remembrance is precisely what should happen.

topics.headline: negated question expects uptake
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the negation as rebuke: will you not remember means the audience should indeed remember.
topics.reason: The reader hears the negation as rebuke: will you not remember means the audience should indeed remember.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural Form V imperfect: ongoing, collective, self-directed remembrance that can become articulated recognition
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers remembering, mentioning, invoking, and related dhikr fields; local verb selects active remembrance or recognition, not unrelated root-family branches
words.prose: {{ar:تَتَذَكَّرُونَ}} ({{tr:tatadhakkarūna}}) is the ayah's demanded uptake. The imperfect second-person plural makes the response present, collective, and direct, in contrast to the completed divine acts already stated. The root presses remembrance toward articulated recognition, while the unrelated gender branch is narrowed away from the local verb. Form V makes the act self-directed and effortful, and the dense repeated sounds make the mouth work through the same effort the word asks of the audience. Across the surah, this word becomes a response test: reminders are accepted or refused (32:15; 32:22), and the boundary from hoped guidance in 32:3 to demanded remembrance here turns creation, governance, and no intermediaries into a direct question about why the audience does not remember.

topics.headline: imperfect plural makes response present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final demand aimed directly at the audience's ongoing collective response, contrasting completed divine acts.
topics.reason: The reader feels the final demand aimed directly at the audience's ongoing collective response, contrasting completed divine acts.

topics.headline: memory presses toward recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees remembrance as active retrieval that can become spoken recognition, while the unrelated gender branch is not locally active.
topics.reason: The reader sees remembrance as active retrieval that can become spoken recognition, while the unrelated gender branch is not locally active.

topics.headline: Form V makes remembrance effortful
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the requested act as reflexive, effortful remembering rather than casual recollection.
topics.reason: The reader notices the requested act as reflexive, effortful remembering rather than casual recollection.

topics.headline: closing reminder formula tests response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing word as the required human uptake to creation, governance, and no intermediaries, with same-surah contrasts in accepted or rejected reminder.
topics.reason: The reader sees the closing word as the required human uptake to creation, governance, and no intermediaries, with same-surah contrasts in accepted or rejected reminder.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The creation verb, the included between-space, six days, the istawa construction, and the throne form one ordered sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is presented as calibrated totality: upper and lower domains, their interval, a numbered duration, and then settled governing support.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring supplies calibration as the functional beginning of the created order.
The middle interval supplies an included spatial joint rather than an omitted remainder.
The exact number supplies bounded staging and resists an instantaneous undifferentiated picture.
A duration supplies the temporal units within which the measured work unfolds.
Rising and settling on something supplies the transition from formation to stable rule.
The support on which an affair stands supplies the governing culmination of the sequence.

changed_reading.before: God created the cosmos and then occupied a throne.
changed_reading.after: A measured, interval-inclusive construction culminates in settled governance; its spatial and temporal joints are part of the claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired negations of a wali and a shafi occur specifically in the relation described as apart from or other than Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse closes two imagined dependency routes: a nearby party who takes charge and a second party who joins a claimant to strengthen a case.

activation_trace.role: Otherness supplies the excluded location from which an alternative dependency chain would have to arise.
Unseparated nearness supplies the intimate access expected of a guardian and is denied as an alternative.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the custodial function that cannot be sourced independently elsewhere.
Joining one thing to another supplies the relational mechanics beneath intercession.
A petitioner joining another's need supplies the advocacy route denied alongside guardianship.

changed_reading.before: There are no helpers besides God.
changed_reading.after: No independent chain of access can begin elsewhere, whether by custodial nearness or by adding a second advocate to one's case.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final question asks for tadhakkur after the whole creation-rule-dependency sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Remembering functions as re-presencing and reassembling the preceding relations, not merely retrieving an isolated proposition.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back after absence supplies the cognitive recovery demanded by the closing question.
A reminder that makes something present supplies the verse itself as an activating device.
A connection between endpoints supplies the relation that memory must restore across the verse's parts.

changed_reading.before: The close is a general invitation to remember God.
changed_reading.after: The close asks the hearer to reconstruct the measured cosmos, its governing source, and the failure of substitute relations as one present model.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus names what is between heaven and earth rather than listing only the two poles.
baseline_models.mechanism: The middle can remain a literal interval while also activating a connective layer through which the two named domains form one system.

activation_trace.role: What is raised overhead supplies the upper pole and enclosing cover of the spatial system.
The lower surface opposite the sky supplies the grounded pole of the system.
The interval supplies real extension separating the poles.
The standing connection between parties supplies a coexisting relational reading of that extension.

changed_reading.before: What lies between heaven and earth is a residual inventory of additional objects.
changed_reading.after: The middle is both populated extent and a connective medium that lets the upper and lower domains operate as one ordered whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The delivered, binding book and the immediately following administration of the affair from heaven to earth and upward again turn the focus order into circulating, communicable rule rather than a static finished structure.

activation_trace.role: Measured formation supplies the ordered substrate through which rule can circulate.
The support of an affair supplies the governing node to which the directional movements are attached.
Delivery downward supplies an initial source-to-recipient movement and makes order communicable.
An inscription that fixes an obligation supplies durable and binding form to the communicated order.
End-aware management supplies ongoing governance rather than mere initial construction.
The affair or state supplies the object continuously governed through the created system.
Ascent supplies the return direction that closes the vertical movement into a circuit.

structural_cues: The descended book precedes the focus, while the next ayah repeats heaven and earth and adds downward administration followed by ascent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, binding inscription, administration, and ascent; I connect them through the focus throne as a circulation of rule. The book's descent and cosmic administration may instead remain parallel movements.

changed_reading.before: The throne marks static completion after creation.
changed_reading.after: The throne sequence opens onto an active regime in which ordered command is delivered, administered through creation, and returned upward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate reuse of day with an explicitly measured magnitude of a thousand counted years reopens the scale of the focus's six days without dissolving their bounded sequence.

activation_trace.role: The exact six supplies a countable sequence whose units still require interpretation.
Duration rather than daylight alone supplies a scale-flexible baseline for the six units.
A second duration immediately after the focus supplies the comparison point that destabilizes an assumed solar scale.
A magnitude reaching a defined limit supplies explicit scalar measurement.
The assembled thousand supplies a scale far beyond the ordinary single-day expectation.
Counting supplies the human frame against which the other magnitude is stated.

structural_cues: Day recurs in the next ayah, where its magnitude is compared with a thousand years of human counting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two adjacent uses of day and an explicit magnitude only for the second; I let that comparison reopen the first unit's scale. It does not prove that both days have the same magnitude.

changed_reading.before: The six days are six ordinary daylight cycles.
changed_reading.after: They are six bounded, countable phases whose magnitude cannot be assumed from human daylight merely from the word day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later human sequence moves from creation through an extracted fluid lineage to proportioning, breath, and life. It supplies an embodied small-scale analogue for the focus movement from measured creation to settled order.

activation_trace.role: Bringing creation into being supplies the macrocosmic starting point for the analogy.
Settled elevation supplies the focus culmination that the bodily sequence reframes as ordered completion rather than inert stopping.
Completed and proportionate form supplies the transition from generic making to shaped creaturely order.
An extracted portion supplies staged derivation rather than undifferentiated production.
Generative fluid in the womb supplies the material carrier of the derived stage.
Straightening and completing the entity supplies the bodily analogue of order brought to stability.
Sending breath into something supplies the directional act that turns formed matter toward animation.
Life-bearing spirit supplies the animation that completes the small-scale sequence.

structural_cues: The later creation account repeats creation and the S-W-Y root inside another staged sequence marked by then.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel sequencing and a root recurrence; I infer a scale analogy between cosmic and bodily ordering, not equivalence between the two S-W-Y forms. The later sequence may illuminate only human formation.

changed_reading.before: Creation and enthronement are a unique cosmic chronology with no embodied analogue.
changed_reading.after: The focus can also be heard as a large-scale pattern of formation, staged completion, and governing animation that later recurs in human making.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same plural addressees who have no substitute guardian or advocate are furnished with hearing, sight, and inward discernment; when those faculties awaken too late, they ask to return. Absence of proxy is paired with nondelegable perception.

activation_trace.role: Another party taking charge supplies the proxy function that the focus removes.
An advocate joining another's need supplies the second proxy route removed by the focus.
Recovered awareness supplies the response expected from the hearer's own faculties.
Putting recipients into a furnished condition supplies deliberate equipment rather than abandonment.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies an inward means of response.
Insight of the heart supplies discernment beyond bare visual reception.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the affective center in which perception becomes accountable.
Belated seeing supplies recognition after the opportunity for ordinary response has closed.
Belated understanding supplies the failed retrospective use of the earlier gift.
A requested return to the former state supplies the reversal that cannot be outsourced to a proxy.

structural_cues: The plural beneficiary construction recurs with the granted faculties, and those same faculties are later voiced in a plea to return and act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied proxies, granted faculties, and their belated activation; I infer nondelegable responsibility as the connecting arrow. The faculties may more narrowly ground gratitude rather than the guardian clause.

changed_reading.before: Having no guardian or intercessor means being left without help.
changed_reading.after: The addressees lack a proxy but are not unequipped: they receive the perceptual means for a response that no later advocate can perform for them.

context_deltas.mechanism: An angel is assigned over the addressees and leaders guide by God's command. These positive subordinate agencies sharpen the focus negation toward autonomous alternatives, not toward the nonexistence of every mediated function.

activation_trace.role: Otherness supplies the decisive exclusion: agency sourced elsewhere is the target.
Taking charge supplies the function later echoed by an explicitly assigned agent.
Joining another's need supplies the mediated function whose independence remains denied.
An angelic agent supplies a real intermediary actor inside the surah's world.

A leader followed by others supplies human mediation as a recognized function.
Gentle direction toward the right path supplies the leaders' operative service.
Binding command supplies the source and limit under which their guidance operates.

structural_cues: The angel is grammatically assigned over the addressees, and the leaders guide explicitly by Our command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command-bound agents; I infer that the focus excludes independent sources rather than all instruments. A stricter alternative is that such agents exist but have no usable guardianship or intercession unless God authorizes it.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies that any intermediary can exist or act.
changed_reading.after: Mediated acts can occur, but no agent becomes a guardian, advocate, or destination sourced apart from the governing command.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning aims to awaken guidance; forgetting the encounter becomes reciprocal abandonment, while being reminded later produces opposite bodily trajectories: falling in submission or turning one's side away. The focus question is therefore a live branching event.

activation_trace.role: A device that makes something present supplies the decision point at the focus close.
Fear-awakening warning supplies the intended activation before the focus question arrives.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the possible movement produced by awakened warning.
Leaving or neglecting something supplies the relational opposite of making it present in memory.
Two things coming face to face supplies the encounter whose neglect gives remembering practical stakes.
The repeated reminder supplies the same stimulus under an enacted positive response.
A sounding, unsteady fall supplies immediate bodily surrender rather than abstract assent.
Lowering in humility supplies the direction and meaning of that fall.
The same reminder supplies a controlled contrast in which stimulus is held constant.
Turning one's side away supplies the opposite embodied trajectory from falling toward submission.

structural_cues: The same passive reminder construction is followed by bodily collapse in 32:15 and bodily turning-away in 32:22; 32:14 places forgetting against the encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reminders and opposed bodily responses; I treat the focus question as their earlier fork. The later scenes may exemplify belief and rejection generally rather than narrate one hearer's timeline.

changed_reading.before: Will you not remember is a low-stakes request for mental recollection.
changed_reading.after: The question activates a bodily and relational fork: make the encounter present and turn toward it, or neglect it and enact estrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The S-W-Y root shifts from settled elevation in the focus to denied equality between two human types; later judgment separates between their differences. Cosmic order therefore need not flatten unlike trajectories but can establish decisive boundaries.

activation_trace.role: Settled elevation supplies the focus image of established order.
A middle interval supplies the initial domain in which ordered relations are held apart and together.
Equality between two parties supplies the branch explicitly negated and prevents stable order from meaning sameness.
A fruit breaking out of its containing skin supplies a material image of boundary breach behind the contrasted type.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the operation that resolves non-equivalence.
Separation after relation supplies the changed function of between at the point of judgment.
A day as a grave event supplies the temporal site where distinction becomes manifest.
Parties taking divergent paths supplies the process that makes final separation coherent.

structural_cues: The focus S-W-Y and B-Y-N roots recur in explicit non-equality and in a later act of separating between disputants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root recurrence, non-equality, and judicial separation; I infer that the focus's cosmic order extends to differentiated outcomes. The recurrence may be lexical resonance without a single governing-order argument.

changed_reading.before: Settled cosmic rule is a uniform order under which all positions are effectively alike.
changed_reading.after: Settled rule can be precisely what preserves boundaries, exposes divergent paths, and refuses to equate unlike responses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence places the nearer or lower punishment short of the greater one and aims at return. That graded use activates duna in the focus as inferiority and failure to reach the governing source, alongside simple otherness.

activation_trace.role: Otherness supplies the baseline exclusion of an alternative source.
Nearness without a gap supplies the access a supposed guardian would need but cannot independently achieve.
Adding a second party supplies the attempted bridge across the shortfall.
The lower or nearer degree supplies one endpoint in an explicit hierarchy.
Being near yet short of the goal supplies the relation between the lesser and greater terms.
Greater magnitude supplies the superior endpoint that reveals the shortfall.
Return supplies the intended movement that the nearer experience is meant to provoke.

structural_cues: In 32:21 the D-N-W, D-W-N, and K-B-R roots occur in one graded construction, followed by hoped-for return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hierarchy in 32:21; I carry its short-of-the-goal sense back into the focus preposition. The focus can still use duna only for other-than, without an active vertical grade.

changed_reading.before: Besides Him marks only categorical otherness.
changed_reading.after: It can also mark hierarchical insufficiency: every proposed guardian or added advocate remains lower than, nearer than, and short of the final governing source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Administration runs from sky to earth, and later water is driven into cut-off ground until growth emerges. The focus's between-space becomes an active transmission path through which rule appears as material provision and regeneration.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky supplies the upper source-domain of the ecological route.

The repeated lower earth supplies the stated destination of administration.
Driving something onward supplies force and direction to the water's movement.
Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies the material transmitted through the route.
Ground stripped of vegetation supplies the blocked initial state that provision reverses.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent capacity to visible effect.
Cultivated growth supplies the route's life-producing output.

structural_cues: The next ayah states a sky-to-earth administrative direction; 32:27 later gives a visible directed flow to earth and its emergent yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the administrative route and the ecological flow; I identify the latter as a material enactment of the former through the focus between-space. They may instead be distinct signs sharing endpoints.

changed_reading.before: What is between heaven and earth is a static third region under a distant throne.
changed_reading.after: The between-space can function as an active conduit where governing direction becomes water, emergence, and renewed life below.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah ends with an opening-day after which newly expressed belief gives no benefit and no respite is granted. The focus's question is thus an opportunity with a closing edge, not an indefinitely repeatable prompt.

activation_trace.role: A reminder that restores presence supplies the present opportunity whose timing matters.

An enclosure opening supplies the anticipated transition into a newly exposed state.
A day as a grave event supplies the decisive temporal threshold.

Benefit opposed to harm supplies the efficacy explicitly unavailable after the threshold.
Waiting or granting time supplies the respite explicitly withheld.
Turning one's side away supplies the commanded disengagement as the warning period closes.
Mutual waiting supplies the final suspended posture before the anticipated opening.

structural_cues: The final three ayat ask when the opening is, deny benefit and delay on its day, and close with reciprocal waiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a no-benefit, no-respite threshold; I read the focus reminder as temporally prior opportunity. Opening can also denote victory, but the stated loss of benefit still gives the prompt an irreversible edge.

changed_reading.before: The call to remember is timeless and can be answered with equal effect whenever recognition arrives.
changed_reading.after: The call is a time-sensitive opening for response before disclosure becomes unavoidable and recognition loses remedial force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines remote material branches for creation and throne with a later water scene. It remains anchored in the focus's creation, sky, between-space, and throne and gains a visible flow in 32:27. Downstream prose should call it a hydraulic analogy, not a lexical translation or a claim about physical cosmography.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Several focus branches can jointly image a rain-receiving basin, a marked upper source, a connector, and the timbered head of a well.

activation_trace.role: A hollow in rock that retains rain supplies basin geometry within the act of creating.
First rain that marks earth with growth supplies an upper input whose effect becomes legible below.
A standing connection supplies the channel linking source, receptacle, and output.
Timbers over a well and the water-drawer's station supply a raised control-head image for the system.
Driving flow supplies the force moving material through the imagined installation.
Delivered irrigation water supplies the installation's working medium.
Generated crop supplies the converted output by which the hidden system becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives only monumental architecture: cosmos below and throne above.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also activates a cosmic wellwork: a raised intake and governing head gathers, routes, and converts water into visible life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses two non-dominant mapped inventories attached to the focus sky root. It remains valid as activation because the packet explicitly supplies those mappings and context adds descent, ascent, and guiding marks. Render it only as branch-play that imagines an interface, never as the gloss of heavens or as a literal perforated cosmology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sky root is split not only toward elevation but also toward visible marking and narrow entry points.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies legibility on the upper boundary.
A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies permeability in that boundary.
A device that restores presence supplies the interpretive act of noticing the boundary's marks.
A distinguishing trace that guides supplies the context's explicit sign-reading function.
Delivery downward supplies passage through the imagined interface.
Upward movement supplies the reverse passage and makes the interface bidirectional.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are only an elevated expanse.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the heavens also become a marked and selectively permeable interface through which hidden order descends, returns, and becomes readable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it recruits the ophthalmic branch of Sh-F-A rather than its advocacy branch. It remains anchored directly in the focus shafi and is activated by the surah's repeated concern with sight. Downstream prose should present it only as a metaphor for imagined doubled agency, never as the lexical meaning of intercessor.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One focus branch for Sh-F-A images an impaired eye seeing one figure as two, beside the explicit exclusion of an other-than relation.

activation_trace.role: The sole object of worship supplies the one governing relation that imagined agency would duplicate.
An other-than relation supplies the imagined second location of agency.
An eye that sees one as two supplies the startling perceptual mechanism for doubling a sole source into two agents.
The granted capacity of sight supplies the perceptual domain in which doubled agency can be diagnosed.
Belated clear seeing supplies correction of perception without producing an additional source of rule.

changed_reading.before: A shafi is simply a second advocate who can improve one's position.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, seeking that second figure resembles double vision: one governing source is misperceived as though agency could be split into two.

strongest_changes: The throne sequence changed from static completion into a descent-and-return administration of communicable order.
The six days changed from assumed solar days into bounded phases whose scale is reopened by the adjacent thousand-year day.
The final memory question changed from mental recollection into an embodied fork between submission and turning away.
The denial of wali and shafi changed from denial of every intermediary into denial of autonomous substitutes, while command-bound agents remain possible.
The between-space changed from residual extent into an ecological conduit where governance becomes directed water and emergent life.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated focus roots returned with different branches and constructions, so spatial, temporal, relational, judicial, bodily, and ecological readings remained distinct but mutually activating; split root mappings also preserved stranger material images instead of collapsing them into the dominant gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The thousand-year day reopens the scale of the six days but does not establish that the two uses have one magnitude.
Delegated agents clearly remain subordinate, but the focus may still deny their practical efficacy more absolutely than the revised model suggests.
The spatial, judicial, and ecological functions of between may be resonant alternatives rather than one integrated mechanism.
The wellwork, aperture, and double-vision readings should remain analogical activations rather than translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Creation as staged proportioning.** `خ ل ق:B001` supplies measuring and proportioning before execution, alongside origination in `خ ل ق:B002`. The merism “heavens, earth, and what is between,” the six-day interval, and *thumma* make sequence and extent explicit; 32:5 then names measure and counting. **Inferred arrow:** articulated stages and measured duration -> prior proportioning governs the act of bringing into being. *Khalaqa* thus reads as calibrated construction as well as origination.

2. **Throne, guardianship, and management form one authority structure.** `س و ي:B003` gives rising and settling upon something; `و ل ي:B003` gives assuming charge and managing an affair. The throne clause is followed by denial of any *walī*, and 32:5 immediately describes outcome-aware management (`د ب ر:B006`). **Inferred arrow:** settled sovereignty -> exclusive charge over the affair -> absence of an independent manager. “No *walī* besides Him” therefore denies a rival administrative center, not only a source of private friendship.

3. **Intercession would be an added agent in the chain.** `ش ف ع:B002` images an advocate or helper joining another, grounded in the pairing image of `ش ف ع:B001`. It is denied beside the *walī* just before 32:5 presents a closed descent-and-ascent circuit. **Inferred arrow:** an intercessor’s joining -> insertion of an auxiliary causal agent; the negation blocks that insertion. The clause reads spatially and operationally: no second party can attach itself to the governed chain as an autonomous modifier.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 32:5 actualized the authority implied by the throne through `د ب ر:B006`, while 32:9 showed that those without another protector or intercessor are nevertheless given hearing, sight, and hearts. The surprise was that 32:4's denial of substitute agency is paired with equipment for direct accountable response, not abandonment.

baseline.text: Gökleri, yeri ve ikisi arasındakileri altı günde yaratan, sonra Arş'ın üzerine yükselen Allah'tır. Sizin O'ndan başka bir koruyucunuz ve şefaatçiniz yoktur. Hatırlamaz mısınız?

findings.text: Ölçülü ve aşamalı yaratılışın ardından Arş'a yerleşme, yönetimi yaratılıştan kopuk bir sahne değil, kusursuz oranlamanın yönetimle tamamlanması olarak gösterir.
Koruyucu ve şefaatçinin birlikte reddi, eksiksiz yönetim zincirine bağımsız bir koruma katmanı ya da sonucu değiştirecek ek bir aracı sokulamayacağını belirtir.
Göklerle yer arasındaki alan, boş bir aralık değil, sonradan hükümle ayrıştırılacak ilişkilerin de içinde bulunduğu düzenli bir bağlar alanı olarak görünür.

One would stand near enough to administer or support; the other would make an isolated petitioner into a pair. Their absence leaves the vertical government without a parallel office or supplementary advocate.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, nesnenin kesilmesi ya da işlenmesi öncesinde ölçülmesini ve sınırlarının uygun biçimde belirlenmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Deri örneği bu işlemi somutlaştırır; yoktan var etme ve yalan uydurma anlamları bu dalın parçası değildir.

facets.statement: Nesnenin ölçüsü ve sınırları yapılacak işten önce belirlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı ölçme, oranlama ve kesmeden önce sınır koyma çevresinde birleştirir; düzgün ve uygun ölçü vurgusu da bu çekirdeği tamamlar.

error_profile.preserves: Ön ölçme ve sınır belirleme işlemlerinin ikisini de korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri, kumaş veya benzeri bir nesnenin kesime hazırlanmasını anlatan bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ölçmenin eylemden önce geldiğini ve kesime yöneldiğini korur.

error_profile.collision: Belirsiz bir kestirimle ölçüye dayalı hazırlığı birbirine karıştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı bir şeyi ortaya çıkarma ve var etme çekirdeğinde birleşir, fakat bunu hem öncesiz bir örnek olmadan meydana getirme hem de bir şeyden başka bir şey oluşturma biçiminde kullanır. Üretici adı ile yaratılanlar topluluğu da eylemden türeyen ayrı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım, var etmenin iki kapsamını korur; üreticiyi ve yaratılanları adlandıran kullanımları çekirdekle birleştirmez.

Eylemi yapan üretici ile ortaya çıkan varlıklar eylem adından türeyen biçimlerle adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı dıştan görülen biçimin tamamlanması, dengeli oluşu ve görünür duruma gelmesi üzerinde birleşir. Genel bir güzellik yargısı zorunlu değildir; asıl ölçüt oluşumun tamamlanması ve biçimin gözle seçilebilmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal görünür beden ve biçimle sınırlıdır; iç huyu veya yalnızca güzel görünmeyi tanımlamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal dış görünüşün oluşmuş ve dengeli olmasını anlatır; iç karakter veya başka kalıpların anlamları eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın dıştan görülebilen biçiminin tamamlanmış, dengeli ve belirgin hale gelmiş olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Dış biçim tamamlanmış ve gözle seçilebilir durumdadır.
İnsan bedeninde tamamlık ve ölçülü görünüş özellikle vurgulanır.
Gelişmekte olan beden taslağının biçiminin belirmesi de bu tamamlanma ekseninde anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar görünür şekil, beden yapısının tamamlanması ve parçaların dengeli biçimde belirmesi üzerinde birleşir; oluşumu henüz görünür olmayan durum bunun karşısında yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bedenin veya nesnenin görünür yapısının tamamlanmış ve ölçülü olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görünürlük, tamamlanma ve dengeli biçim özelliklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Oluşum sürecindeki bir bedenin ya da parçanın görünür yapısının belirdiği bağlama uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Biçimin oluşmasını ve tamamlanmasını açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Dengeli ve ölçülü görünüş vurgusunu açıkça söylemez.

error_profile.preserves: Dış görünüşe ilişkin bir değerlendirme alanını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada yapı bedensel ve görünürdür; komşu dalda ise davranışta beliren iç eğilimdir.
